answer.reason: The verses give James two events the summary does not state: an appearance of Christ to him and his fellowship with Paul and Barnabas.

clauses.english: was one of those to whom Christ appeared
clauses.quote: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.

clauses.english: gave Paul and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship to go to the Gentiles
clauses.quote: they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship

doubts: 1CO 15:7 does not name Christ or say he had risen; both come from the neighbouring verses, which are only partly given.
ACT 15:13 shows James speaking at the council, but the verses given do not state what he said, so I left it out.
Some marked verses (ACT 12:17, ACT 15:13, ACT 21:18, GAL 2:12) may mean a different James; I did not rely on them.
